resources.string: Used to access and manage all files on the device to ensure backup and restore functions work properly.
Add the app to the battery optimization whitelist to ensure backup and restore services run stably in the background.
Pin the app to the active standby bucket and lift background-run limits, so long tasks are less likely to be frozen halfway by the system.
Choose a location to store your backups.
Are you sure you want to skip the setup?
This version only supports %1$s, but your device architecture is %2$s. Please install %3$s version.
Application requires root access to function properly.
You can set these later in settings.
Please remember your repository password. Without it you cannot restore backups from this repository. If you don\'t want to set one, keeping the default password is recommended.

A higher level means a higher compression ratio but slower speed and more resource usage. Choose a level that suits your device. This setting only takes effect when initializing the repository; changing it afterwards will not affect an existing repository.
Run the compression test below first: until it finishes you cannot initialize the repository, change the compression level, or continue.
Benchmark recommends %1$s, not applied yet (tap Apply above)

A new repository will be created with compression level %1$s; initialization starts as soon as you tap Initialize. A compression level that does not match your device performance can make backups extremely slow, so the level recommended by the test above is advised. The level cannot be changed after initialization — switching levels later requires deleting and re-initializing the repository, which permanently deletes existing backups.

A repository already exists in this directory: it will be opened with the current password instead of being initialized again (%1$s). The compression level is only written at creation time, so a new recommendation does not affect an existing repository.
The repository exists but the password check failed.\n%1$s
Repository verification timed out. Make sure root access is working, then retry.
Failed to delete the repository. Check storage space and permissions, then retry.

An existing repository was found, but the password does not match.
Path: %1$s

If you still remember the original password, go back and enter it. Otherwise you can delete this repository — that permanently removes every backup inside it. Deleting only removes the repository; you will have to enter a password and tap Initialize again, it does not rebuild automatically.

The previous repository was deleted: %1$s\n\nDeleting and initializing are two separate steps: the password field is back to the default password, confirm it and tap Initialize to create a new repository; edit the field first if you want a different password. In \'Open existing repository\' mode, select the directory again first.

Take a screenshot of the details below now. The repository password is shown in full only here, once — close this dialog and it cannot be displayed again, and a forgotten password means the backups cannot be restored.

Every backup inside this repository will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
Path: %1$s

Nothing is re-initialized automatically afterwards: you will need to enter a password and tap Initialize.

Failed to open the repository. Make sure you selected the repository folder itself (the one copied completely from the old device, containing config/data/keys) and the password matches the original repository exactly.

Restore from an old device: you MUST select the repository folder you actually copied over (or its parent folder, the restic_repo subfolder is detected automatically), then open it with the password of the old device. IMPORTANT: the folder you select decides which repository is opened, and it is NOT necessarily the default path shown below. Selecting the wrong folder or using a password that differs from the original repository both fail.
The defaults below are only applied when creating a NEW repository. They are provided for reference only. Long-press to select or tap the copy button to copy.

The password must be identical to the original repository, otherwise its backups cannot be restored. If the repository is deleted by mistake, all backups inside it are lost permanently. Please operate with caution.
